author: (C.Agardh) J.Agardh, 1846

note.en: A soft, blade-like red seaweed with a midrib. Known from herbarium specimens from Puerto Limón (1962 and a record as Cryptonemia luxurians from the Limón shore).
note.es: Un alga roja blanda, parecida a una hoja, con nervadura central. Se conoce por especímenes de herbario de Puerto Limón (1962 y un registro como Cryptonemia luxurians de la costa de Limón).

evidence: GBIF: 2 herbarium specimen records in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: Known from herbarium specimens from Puerto Limón (1962 and a record as Cryptonemia luxurians from the Limón shore).
